newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli shekel weakens against dollar, basket.
newsitem.headline: Israeli shekel weakens against dollar, basket.

text.p: The Israeli shekel declined on Wednesday against the dollar and the basket of foreign currencies in quiet trading, dealers said.
"Trading was very quiet today and activity was low. The business sector was buying dollars on a low scale and the shekel declined because of the low volume," said a dealer at Israel Discount Bank.

The representative rate for the dollar was fixed at 3.2670 shekels against 3.2560 on Tuesday. The basket, composed of the dollar, mark, pound sterling, French franc and yen, closed at 3.6664 shekels against 3.6514 on Tuesday.
On the crosses the shekel traded against the yen at 2.8589 shekels per 100 yen against 2.8614 on Tuesday and against the mark at 2.1634 shekels against 2.1565 on Tuesday.
In late afternoon the dollar was trading at 3.2650 shekels.
